Repeated rows under the stated comparison and missing-value policy
Single-column, composite, and nearly unique keys
Verified long layout and relationships in its wide form
Exact or approximate value mappings, including multi-column determinants
Pairwise order between two columns (a <= b), exact or with counted violations
Alternative labels for a grouping and finer-to-coarser rollups
Order in the row sequence and late appended backfills
Changes between fractional and integer-valued recording
Repeated, windowed candidate missing-value codes
Mass piled at a numeric column's minimum or maximum, and interior mass points in zero-inflated columns
Each column's missing rate, the grouping level, threshold, or time point it follows, and columns missing on the same rows
What text columns hold (numbers, dates, recognized formats), label variants and likely misspellings, repeated extremes, stray signs, zero inflation, separated modes, and far-out dates
Absent steps on the time axis; trend, cycle and persistence of each measure; grouping levels that appear, end or shift share over time

Heaping, terminal-digit preferences, and eligible Benford deviations
Inferred calendar gaps and interval irregularity
Declared sequences, calendars, ordering, and panel completeness
Per-period row and entity volume on the time axis, against the typical period
How one declared subset of the rows differs from the rest of the table
Each level of a categorical column against the pooled rest on each numeric measure: location, scale, and constant-multiple contrasts, plus the date axis's calendar parts
Predictability of eligible columns from the other columns
Compact predictive tables selected by cross-validation
Multi-condition rules for categorical targets

Non-additive predictor pairs under a fitted target model

Line, curve, and step comparisons for a designated numeric target
A column that determines the designated target exactly, or relates to it far more strongly than any other column does — the signature of a column derived from the outcome or recorded after it

Sustained level, trend, variance changes, and transient excursions

Axis-aligned and diagonal threshold jumps
Reference-period model-routing changes along a declared time axis
Distribution changes in the measures jointly along the time axis, from classifier-based changepoint detection
Searched conjunctions of conditions under which a target column's distribution shifts, confirmed on held-out rows
Shape of a response along an ordered axis (monotonicity, reversal blocks, saturation) and located level, trend, slope, regime, and spike events along it, including inside one categorical level
Pairwise nominal rules with train and diagnostic evidence
Combinations concentrated beyond their marginal frequencies, in rows or in a declared weight
Pearson, Spearman, and both directions of Chatterjee's xi
Affine and small multi-term arithmetic relationships
Changes in pairwise correlation across calendar or year periods
Experimental shared row partitions, cluster differences, and density findings
Each entity's mix over each dimension, compared across entities: groups of entities with a similar mix, a continuum, entities that match no group, and specialists
